mcinnis: “Nurse McInnis,” said Helen, and the nurse smiled steadily as they all did, and said that she did not find many people who were frightened of her.
But the little old women became Helen and Nurse McInnis after a time, standing in the window together whispering, whispering incessantly.
At last there was a rustling on the stairs overhead, and Nurse McInnis came down fastening the links in her cuffs, in preparation for the night’s watch.
